name: The Sacred Flame's world map area sits on the Ashenvale Moonwell (#7722)
contract: quest_poi 1195/1 is the stock area row for quest 1195 (Flags 1, eight points) but carries ObjectiveIndex 10, which addresses item objective slot 6, empty for this quest (RequiredItemId1-6 are 0), so the world map draws no area for it.
quest_poi 1195/2 carries ObjectiveIndex 5 and one point, the pin at 1888 -1776 that the issue reports as the map's correct location.

A real client asks CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY for the quests in its log and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE (opcode 484, QueryHandler.cpp:431-469): quest count, then per quest the quest id, a POI count, and per POI its id, objective index, map, area, floor, priority, flags, point count and integer world points, in quest_poi id order.

Expectation: quest 1195 answers with three POIs; the area row carries ObjectiveIndex 5, Flags 1 and eight points ringed 14 yd around the Ashenvale Moonwell (gameobject 20806); the pin row keeps Flags 3 and its point.
